name: Multiresolution Texture-Based Cutting Plane Rendering
definition: An adaptive scheme for rendering arbitrarily oriented cutting planes through large volumetric data sets at varying resolutions. It uses an octree decomposition of texture space where leaves store original data and internal nodes store lower-resolution versions. Rendering selects high-resolution cells near a point-of-interest and low-resolution cells away from it, blending between levels to reduce artifacts.
summary: Multiresolution Texture-Based Cutting Plane Rendering adaptively blends high and low resolution octree tiles to render cutting planes through volumetric data, prioritizing detail near a point of interest.
